dedupe_keys.name: construction of waste to resource knowledge graph for industrial symbiosis identification using large language models

description: The repository authors publish a Python pipeline for extracting waste-to-resource links from research text and writing an industrial-symbiosis knowledge graph. Zenodo archives release 1.0 with an Apache 2.0 licence and links a GitHub repository. Its README describes LLM extraction from abstracts, optional full-text processing, evaluation against labelled relations, entity fusion and Neo4j export. The repository also points to graph data. This tool can prepare candidate material-exchange edges for industrial network simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this pipeline. Coverage depends on the papers, prompts, language models and relation labels supplied by a user, not a complete global exchange network. A limitation is that some full-text steps require separate access and an API key; neither was used here. Extraction errors and model dependence affect any downstream network. The code was not executed, no full text was fetched and graph accuracy was not reproduced.
